logger.doc:name: Log Inbound
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { layer: "PROCESS - ORDERS FLOW", event: "INBOUND REQUEST FROM EXP API", correlationId: correlationId, payload: payload, timestamp: now() }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var eligibleSkus = vars.stockCheck.eligibleItems map (i) -> i.sku --- { customer: vars.orderObject.customer, orderChannel: vars.orderObject.orderChannel, paymentMode: vars.orderObject.paymentMode, items: vars.orderObject.items map (item) -> item ++ { isEligible: eligibleSkus contains item.sku}, deliveryPreference: vars.orderObject.deliveryPreference }

logger.doc:name: Log system request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { layer: "PROCESS - ORDERS FLOW", event: "SYSTEM API REQUEST", correlationId: correlationId, sysInput: vars.sysInput, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.stockCheck.ineligibleItems map { phoneNumber: vars.orderObject.customer.phoneNumber, sku: $.sku, quantity: $.requested_qty, isEligible: ($.exists and $.sufficient), orderChannel: vars.orderObject.orderChannel, paymentMode: vars.orderObject.paymentMode, deliveryPreference: vars.orderObject.deliveryPreference }

logger.doc:name: Log Response to Exp
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { layer: "PROCESS - ORDERS FLOW", event: "RESPONSE TO EXPERIENCE API", correlationId: correlationId, sysInput: payload, timestamp: now() }]

logger.doc:name: Log Response to Exp
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { layer: "PROCESS - INVENTORY FLOW", event: "STOCK AVAILABILITY RESPONSE TO EXPERIENCE API", correlationId: correlationId, response: payload, timestamp: now() }]
